This API operation retrieves the available sharing options for snapshots in Grafana. When invoked via a GET request to the /snapshot/shared-options endpoint, it returns configuration details about how snapshots can be shared, including available sharing methods, permissions, and any constraints or settings that govern snapshot sharing behavior within the Grafana instance. This information is useful for determining what sharing capabilities are enabled and how users can distribute dashboard snaps
